products.product_description: Henning's Wisconsin Cheese Colby Jack, Colby & Monterey Jack Blended Together. Packaged in 1 lb., 2 lb, and mammoth wheels (A mammoth wheel can be classified as anything 75 lbs. and larger).
products.code_info: The small sticker on the bottom of the 1 lb. and 2 lb. cheese packages has the first four digits of 1007. The Mammoth wheels list 4/10/17.
products.reason_for_recall: A new pasteurizer and temperature chart recorder were installed. While pasteurizing the first vat, the chart recorder paper jammed and did not record the time and temperature of the milk.
